name: livekit-voicelab
description: LiveKit VoiceLab — a dashboard for testing real LiveKit Voice AI capabilities end to end.

scripts.build:shared: node init && npm run build --workspace packages/shared
scripts.dev: node init && npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,agent,client -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:agent: node init && npm run dev --workspace agent
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace agent && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init
